messages:
Maya (CSM): Heads-up: Cedar procurement wants a milestone payment schedule and put NET60 on final PO. They proposed 3-way split: 30% CC at signature, 30% PO NET30, 40% PO NET60. Also asked for W-9/vendor docs and a 1-page services appendix. Can we accept?
Luis (AE): They want to keep current pricing. Willing to do milestones to satisfy audit. Asking if we can accept PO NET60 for final tranche only.
Sam (Cedar): Confirming: internal audit requires milestone invoices. We'll push procurement to include vendor code and vendor W9 on PO. DocuSign is ok if PO references the signed agreement.
Tara (Billing): Milestone invoicing increases reconciliation work. Finance needs vendor W9, remit-to, PO number format and a clear acceptance criteria tied to milestones. Also need CC auth capture for 30% upfront.
Procurement Bot: Note: "Milestone billing requires Legal-approved acceptance criteria and Finance sign-off. NET60 on any tranche >30% requires Credit Ops review."
Maya (CSM): @Revenue Ops please confirm revenue recognition impact. Tagging Legal Ops for acceptance language.
Revenue Ops: For milestone schedule make sure invoice milestones map to deliverables. With 40% NET60 final tranche we need contract amendment noting delivery/acceptance triggers so revenue can be deferred properly. Send draft schedule.
Legal Ops: We can draft a one-pager appendix listing 3 milestones + acceptance checklist. Signature options: (1) DocuSign amendment + appendix, (2) PO referencing Master Agreement v1 + countersigned PDF. If PO has NET60 on final, we need explicit email approval from Revenue Ops/Finance on thread before invoicing.
Luis (AE): Proposed compromise: 30% CC, 35% PO NET30, 35% PO NET60 (reduces exposure). Would that help approvals?
Revenue Ops: 35/35 still ok if the acceptance criteria are clear. Prefer 50% upfront for simpler accounting, but can accept milestone plan with amendment. Need a revenue schedule table.
Sam (Cedar): Procurement prefers 30/30/40 but can take 30/35/35 if it helps. Will confirm vendor code and send PO draft tomorrow.
Tara (Billing): Example invoice header we'll need on PO: `VendorCode: RWINF-23\nTaxID: 11-2233445\nPO: CEDR-2026-221`
Maya (CSM): Action items: (1) Legal Ops to draft 1-page appendix with milestones + acceptance (2) Luis to propose 30/35/35 & email procurement (3) Sam to send PO draft + vendor docs (4) Tara to build invoice templates and CC capture link (5) Revenue Ops to prepare revenue schedule table.
Onboarding Eng: Note for kickoffs: we'll require the 30% CC to clear before scheduling live training. We can begin documentation handoff earlier.
Revenue Ops: Drafting revenue schedule, will post spreadsheet link when ready.
Legal Ops: Appendix draft ready, sharing in DM to Maya.
Tara (Billing): Payment link and invoice templates ready, ETA EOD.
Luis (AE): Reached out to procurement with the 30/35/35 option. Will update here. :sparkles:
Maya (CSM): Great work. Please react with :white_check_mark: when deliverables are uploaded. Keep thread for approvals; I'll update when PO or signed amendment arrives.
